thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026 triggered -> page fired for service=redwood-inference-serving, symptom=az2 high 5xx ratio, priority=high. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: INC-2026: Trigger rule 'az2-serving-5xx-threshold' fired. Symptoms: 5xx spike from az2 nodes -> ~18% error rate over 5m. Notifying on-call rota.

Alice Chen: acked. I'm oncall for infra, starting triage.

Charlie O'Neill: +1 I'm here too, switching to incident context. Any customer-impact flags yet?

Bob M.: I'm seeing increased errors on the routing layer towards az2, looks like grpc timeouts then 502 from backends.

Alice Chen: running quick healthcheck across cluster.

Alice Chen: ```
$ k get pods -n inference -l az=az2 -o wide
NAME                         READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-srv-az2-0          1/1     Running   0          12d
inference-srv-az2-1          0/1     CrashLoop 5          3h
inference-srv-az2-2          1/1     Running   0          4d
```

Alice Chen: one replica in az2 is crashlooping with oom/kvcache eviction logs. Pulling logs.

Bob M.: logs show repeated `kv_cache_rehydrate` timeouts and then oom-killer on the worker process. Candidate root cause: kvcache corruption on that shard, causing excessive mem churn.

Charlie O'Neill: Customers: A/B tests show latency spikes for ~8% of requests routed to az2, errors are affecting multi-tenant customers (some 5xx from generation endpoints). Not yet widespread but trending up.

SRE Lead: tagging this as regional-impact and recommending traffic diversion immediately if service-level is degraded. Please prepare redirect/playbook.

Alice Chen: proposing automated redispatch of new requests away from az2 to us-west-az1/us-east-az3 for 15m while we remediate. We have a routing policy `regional-redispatch-v2` that can be applied per-customer.

Ops Next: do we want canary diversion first (10%) or immediate full diversion? We should consider burst on target zones.

Charlie O'Neill: recommend progressive: start at 30% for 5m observe, then 60%, then 100%. If target zones show degradation, rollback to 0%.

Alice Chen: executing redispatch via `routerctl` now.

Alice Chen: ```
$ routerctl apply-policy --policy regional-redispatch-v2 --from-region az2 --to-regions us-west-az1,us-east-az3 --initial-weight 30
Applied policy regional-redispatch-v2 -> initial_weight=30%
```

pagerduty: INC-2026: Acknowledged by Alice Chen. Escalation timer paused.

Charlie O'Neill: monitoring metrics: after 3m, az2 5xx dropped from 18% -> 7%, target zones saw minor CPU uptick but error rate stable.

Bob M.: starting remediation on the crashlooping node: drain + restart container with forced kvcache rebuild.

Alice Chen: command to drain: ```
$ kubectl cordon inference-srv-az2-1 && kubectl drain inference-srv-az2-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

Alice Chen: restarted container with `--kvcache-rebuild` flag. Logs show rebuild started.

Charlie O'Neill: keep traffic at 30% for another 4m while rebuild proceeds. Informing support to notify affected customers: low severity outage but mitigated by diversion.

SRE Lead: good. If rebuild finishes and node stable for 10m we can step down weights. Otherwise, plan is to evict the shard and reassign to another node.

Ops Next: deployed a temporary autoscale rule on us-west-az1 to add 2 extra pods to handle redistributed traffic.

Bob M.: rebuild logs: `kvcache: rebuild completed, shard healthy`. Observed memory stable.

Charlie O'Neill: metrics update: az2 5xx -> 2.1%, latency normalized. We can begin stepping traffic back in controlled increments.

Alice Chen: modifying policy to step back weights -> 60% now.

Alice Chen: ```
$ routerctl set-weight regional-redispatch-v2 --from az2 --weight 60
```

pagerduty: INC-2026: Note: incident changed state -> under control. Auto-escalation timer resumed but at lower priority.

SRE Lead: after 30m we should run a brief postmortem: cause looks like kvcache rehydrate edge-case leading to OOM on that node. Need to look at kvcache crash handling and add better isolation.

Charlie O'Neill: handing off to follow-up owner for post-incident: Alice Chen -> please coordinate with infra-ml and routing team. On-call handoff to Ops Next for the next shift.

Alice Chen: ack. I'll create INC-2026 follow-up ticket and link root-cause analysis.

Ops Next: taking handoff, on-call for the next 8h. Will monitor for regression and notify if any rollback required.

pagerduty: INC-2026: Incident annotated: mitigation=regional-redispatch, node_rebuild, result=service stabilized.

incident-bot: Incident resolved? Please confirm closure when RCAs are posted. :white_check_mark:

Alice Chen: will post RCA in ~24h after digging deeper. Closing the immediate paging loop. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
